## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and they failed before the change (red/green)
- [ ] `make test vet fmt` passes
- [ ] `cd web && npm test` passes (if `web/` changed)
- [ ] Ran `make web` if anything under `web/` changed
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior, config, or the API changed (README / ARCHITECTURE / in-app docs)
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, or AI-attribution trailers in the diff
